facts.claim: Official Canadian and Alberta sources describe Alberta as producing most of Canada's natural gas.

sources.excerpt: In 2023, natural gas production in Alberta averaged 10.9 Bcf/d. Alberta produced 61% of Canada's total natural gas production in 2023.
sources.title: Provincial and Territorial Energy Profiles - Alberta

sources.excerpt: Alberta produces more than half of all the natural gas in Canada.
sources.title: Natural gas

sources.excerpt: Canada is among the world's top 5 producers of natural gas, with about two-thirds of production coming from Alberta.
